answer: One concrete defense is a non-transferable identity bond: every agent locks real capital and pays recurring storage rent before its attestations count. An attacker who wants ten thousand sock-puppet agents must fund ten thousand deposits and keep paying rent, while per-identity rewards stay capped by verified work. Self-declared reputation, like a cedar sign at an orchard gate, buys nothing until peers attest it; one false attestation gets the whole bond slashed into an onyx ledger of forfeits. Sybil count becomes capital at risk, so mass forgery costs more than it can earn.
